# Parth Aggarwal

> Technical Platform Product Manager. Forward Deployed Product Manager at Backbase since Aug 2026. Built a $2B+/yr virtual card disbursement platform for a Fortune 3 enterprise, architected and launched a multi-tenant, multi-geography financial data platform sold to US and EMEA banks, and now owns Backbase's agentic AI connector platform. Led GTMs with 0 P1/P2 defects and owned platform economics.

- Based in: Hyderabad, India. Product and platform roles, India and global. Open to relocation. Full-time.
- Experience: 5+ years in B2B SaaS (since Feb 2021), 4+ in fintech, from 0-to-1 through enterprise scale.
- Contact: 8parthaggarwal1999@gmail.com · https://linkedin.com/in/aggarwalparth

## Headline results

- $2B+ a year in virtual card disbursements, Optum (UnitedHealth Group, Fortune 3)
- ~80% faster connector builds at Backbase (~12 days to ~2) with agents over MCP
- 150K+ cards issued, Sparrow Card, Zeta's first US credit card program
- 90 days cut from bank onboarding and GTM (4 months to 1)

## Case studies

- [Connector Studio MCP - agent-built banking connectors](https://parth8.github.io/portfolio/#case-1) (Backbase, Aug 2026 - present): ~80% faster connector builds (~12 days to ~2). Owns Connector Studio end-to-end: Backbase's iPaaS for banking connectors, in the web app and as an agentic AI MCP. Shipped the MCP in six weeks; banks and ~20 internal PMs and services engineers now build connectors with agents.
- [Virtual card issuance platform for a Fortune 3](https://parth8.github.io/portfolio/#case-2) (Zeta, for Optum Financial / UnitedHealth Group, 2024 - 2026): $2B+ a year disbursed to US healthcare providers. Led the 0 P1/P2 defect production launch of a virtual card platform for UnitedHealthcare payers to disburse $2B+ a year to US healthcare providers, with Optum Bank as sponsor bank, on Mastercard rails.
- [Multi-tenant data platform for US + EMEA banks](https://parth8.github.io/portfolio/#case-3) (Zeta, May 2024 - Aug 2026): $50K/yr infra cost removed; onboarding + GTM cut by 90 days. Lead platform PM for a multi-tenant, config-driven data platform (DPaaS) serving enterprise banks in the US and EMEA. Banks onboard by subscription with zero code changes.
- [Sparrow Card US launch - Zeta's first US credit card](https://parth8.github.io/portfolio/#case-4) (Zeta, with Evolve Bank, May 2022 - May 2024): 150K+ cards issued; 2x revenue projections. Led Zeta's first US credit card client launch, Sparrow Card with Evolve Bank, from onboarding through BAU operations, and built the US support and ops function from scratch.

## Built solo

- [Track](https://parth8.github.io/track/): A calm, ad-free live tracker for Indian trains and flights.
- [Shelfie](https://parth8.github.io/shelfie/): A reading tracker you drive with your thumbs.
- [Decoding Credit Cards](https://parth8.github.io/credit/): 22 interactive chapters on how credit cards actually work.
- [Zero to a Hundred](https://parth8.github.io/ai/): An open, vendor-neutral curriculum for learning AI in 21 phases.
- [Jira 2.0](https://parth8.github.io/jira2/): A product teardown and working prototype of an AI-native layer on Jira.
- [GRID](https://parth8.github.io/grid/): An editorial reference for Formula 1's 2026 reset, with live timing.
- [The Cookbook](https://parth8.github.io/cookbook/): 216 high-protein dishes that start from context, not chapters.

## Gaps, stated plainly

- Managing PMs (direct reports) (gap): No direct reports who are PMs on record. Has led 8 engineers and 3 CSMs, and coordinates ~20 internal PMs as MCP users at Backbase.
- Consumer growth & experimentation (adjacent): Career is mostly B2B; consumer evidence is the Sparrow credit card launch, HDFC DAU/MAU dashboards and consumer side projects, not growth experimentation at scale.
- ML model training & data science (adjacent): Integrated ML fraud detection (FeatureSpace) and owns LLM evals; has not trained models himself.
- Native mobile apps (adjacent): Builds installable web apps (PWAs) tuned for phones; no native iOS/Android product on record.
